categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes address selection inside buckets in src/addrman.cpp and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a severe statistical bias in addrman bucket selection that skewed peer connection selection toward entries following empty slots. As the description demonstrates, entries in sparse buckets could face extreme sampling disparities (e.g., 95.3% versus 4.7%), undermining uniform peer sampling and eclipse resistance across buckets.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The changes in test files are unit and fuzz tests pinning addrman behavior rather than changes to test runner machinery or general test utilities.
categories.rationale: Does not touch shared test framework infrastructure; tests pinning domain logic belong strictly to the domain category.
